name: com.michaelo.oxgkit.inputsystem
description: The OxGKit is a system tool kit commonly used in game development based on Unity design (all are independent tools).

samples.description: Demonstrates the full dispatch chain: a PlayerControls control map (Unity Input System asset + generated class), a custom MoveInput binding composite, a PlayerAction IInputAction re-dispatching events, Inputs.IA.DriveUpdate, and gameplay subscription.

Agent Skill (SKILL.md) that teaches AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, etc.) how to use the InputSystem: Inputs.CM control maps, IInputAction dispatchers, DriveUpdate loops, and binding composites. Copy the skill folder into your agent's skills directory after import (see the sample's README).
